subject: Post-demo: Zensight model fit and safety evaluation plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha@zensighthealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Zensight model fit and safety evaluation plan

Hi Asha / Liam —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time and the product tour. Quick recap + proposed next steps based on the discovery:

1) Primary objectives you shared
- Generate triage-level clinical summaries from intake transcripts (non-diagnostic)
- Route sensitive PHI content to human review when model is uncertain
- Keep 95th-percentile inference latency under 350ms for single-turn queries

2) Initial model fit recommendations (high-level)
- Mistral-Instruct-7B (quantized): best cost/latency tradeoff for non-critical summarization and throughput tests.
- Llama-3-70B-ptq (safety-tuned): stronger refusal behavior on policy probes, recommended for canary/QA runs where safety is critical (higher cost).
- Smaller distilled candidate (Redwood-lite-3B): good for low-cost routing for low-risk content.

3) Safety / refusal focus (what we propose to test)
- PHI detection + forced-refusal prompts: prompt-level guardrails that steer the model to "escalate to human" on sensitive PII/PHI.
- Policy probes and red-team prompts: simulated medical-advice attempts, social-engineering prompts.
- Regression checks vs your acceptance set (we flagged ~12 sample prompts you shared where we expect strict refusals).

4) Deliverables and timing (proposed)
- Week 0 (this week): share prompt_set_v2.txt + baseline eval checklist (attached). [attachment: prompt_set_v2.txt (text/plain)]
- Week 1: Redwood runs benchmark suite across the three recommended candidates and returns latency/cost matrix + refusal rates.
- Week 2: Joint review call to pick pilot model and rollout policy (canary + fallback).

Attachments: zensight_eval_checklist.xlsx, prompt_set_v2.txt, latency_cost_estimates.pdf (draft).
Related links: https://docs.redwood.com/benchmarks/zensight-2027 (initial benchmark doc).

Action items for your side: confirm procurement contact and data access window for pilot data (S3 link or secure upload).

If that looks good I can schedule the benchmark run and loop in Aditya (solutions) for the safety probes.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Asha Menon <asha@zensighthealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@zensighthealth.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Zensight model fit and safety evaluation plan

Thanks Ben — this is helpful. A few quick clarifications before we lock the timeline: 

- Can you include an expected p95 latency and per-token cost estimate for each model candidate in the Week 1 deliverable? We need concrete numbers to compare against our SLOs.
- For PHI handling: we are SOC 2 Type II in process. We need to confirm whether logs and KV cache are retained by Redwood in any form during pilot — please include the data retention policy snippet.
- Procurement: please include an initial quote we can hand off to procurement (contact listed below).

Procurement contact: procurement@zensighthealth.com (Sara Milton, Procurement Manager).

Also can you send an example refusal prompt and one sample red-team prompt so our internal compliance can pre-review?

Appreciate it — Asha
Asha Menon | Head of Product | Zensight Health
asha@zensighthealth.com | +1 (650) 555-2298

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha@zensighthealth.com>, Liam Chen <liam.chen@zensighthealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Jan 2027 11:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Zensight model fit and safety evaluation plan

Asha — thanks for the notes. Quick responses inline and attached artifacts: 

- Latency / cost estimates: see latency_cost_estimates.pdf (attached). Short summary: Mistral-7B quantized p95 ~ 220–300ms (regional variance), ~ $0.0025 per 1k tokens; Llama-3-70B-ptq p95 ~ 320–420ms, ~ $0.013 per 1k tokens. Numbers are conservative and assume single-request routing (no prefix cache).
- Data retention: Redwood pilot config supports zero-log mode (no request bodies retained) and KV cache TTLs configurable per-customer. I'll attach a one-page policy snippet and we can include it in the SOW.
- Procurement quote: I'll generate a one-page estimate and site it under the HubSpot deal. HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ZN-2027-004
- Refusal / red-team samples: added two examples at the bottom of prompt_set_v2.txt (included). Example refusal template: ">Customer asked for diagnosis. Model response: \"I’m not able to provide medical diagnoses. I can summarize available information and suggest discussing with a licensed clinician. Would you like me to do that?\"

Action items (owners):
- Redwood (Aditya): run benchmark suite + refusal probes across three candidates (ETA 5 business days).
- Zensight (Asha): provide S3 access or secure upload by Monday; confirm procurement contact.
- Redwood (Ben): draft pilot estimate / SOW for procurement handoff.

Attachments included: zensight_eval_checklist.xlsx, prompt_set_v2.txt, latency_cost_estimates.pdf

Will schedule the kickoff pending your S3 details.

Best,
Ben

Subject: RE: Post-demo: Zensight model fit and safety evaluation plan

Internal note (please keep internal):

Procurement likely to push on price (typical). If they ask for pilot credits, we can offer up to 20% off pilot hours but require commitment to review results within 30 days and an executive sponsor (Asha qualifies).

Aditya — flag anything in the benchmark that increases cost materially (e.g., enabling full KV cache persistence or higher-res tokenization). If safety probes need extra manual labeling, estimate the human review hours separately.

Ben — when you send the SOW, mark the pricing as draft and include the 30-day pilot acceptance clause. I'll be available to join kickoff if needed.

-Marissa
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference

- We confirm kickoff for Monday 25 Jan at 11:00 PT.

Asha
